goal: real 10-bit still photography with a stored 10-bit HEIF/HEIC output path
policy: Do not force com.oplus.10bits.heic.encode.support until every required static layer is verified. RAW10, P010, UltraHDR/JPEG_R and an HEIC encoder are individually insufficient.

evidence: Snapdragon 8 Elite public product material advertises up to 10-bit photo/video capture, 10-bit HEIF/HEIC photo capture and Google Ultra HDR.
Historical OnePlusOSS/oppo-source build feature files expose OPLUS_FEATURE_10BIT_HEIF.
The same feature family includes HEIF converter/optimization and Qualcomm ROI encode integration.
layers.conclusion: OPlus has an official system-level 10-bit HEIF feature lineage; this does not prove the current project-23821 runtime gate is enabled.

evidence: camera_unit_config declares capture_raw10_dol in SAT photo, portrait, motion and macro use cases.
camera_unit_config declares capture_raw10_fullsize in SAT photo use cases.
Professional/HQRAW paths separately expose RAW16/RAW and multi-frame RAW surfaces.
layers.conclusion: OnePlus 13 shipping camera configuration contains substantial RAW10 acquisition paths. This is not a stored 10-bit HEIF proof.

evidence: display/formats.json defines YCBCR_P010 with 10-bit Y, Cb and Cr components.
display/video_alignments.json defines a YCBCR_P010 variant with modifier HW_IMAGE_ENCODER.
layers.conclusion: The shipping SM8750 vendor stack has a concrete 10-bit P010 buffer layout accepted by the hardware image-encoder allocation path.

evidence: Declared dimensions are 512x512 through 16384x16384 with CQ quality control.
The HEIC codec declaration entered the public common extraction by OOS 11.F.74 and has not had a later file-history update in the repository.
layers.conclusion: A shipping Qualcomm HEIC encoder component exists. Its XML block does not state a 10-bit input/output profile.

evidence: OnePlus 13 stock vendor manifest includes libapsultrahdr.
Uploaded FX8U processing addon references UltraHDR/JPEG_R processing and P010 paths.
layers.conclusion: UltraHDR/gain-map and high-precision processing surfaces exist, but JPEG_R/UltraHDR is not equivalent to plain 10-bit HEIF.

evidence: Stock BasicTone configuration contains Str10bit and Dvig10bit parameters in normal/Master/Dolby tuning.
layers.conclusion: A 10-bit-aware tone/dither processing branch exists upstream of storage.

needs: CameraCharacteristics REQUEST_AVAILABLE_CAPABILITIES_DYNAMIC_RANGE_TEN_BIT for relevant still camera path
dynamic-range profile map / recommended ten-bit profile
P010 or PRIVATE stream support tied to the target camera path rather than only allocator capability
layers.conclusion: Static vendor files show P010 infrastructure but do not yet prove the complete Android public 10-bit still HAL contract for project 23821.

needs: explicit Codec2/OMX input color format or profile accepting P010/Main10 for c2.qti.heic.encoder
or target userspace evidence that OPlus still encoding feeds P010/10-bit samples to this component
layers.conclusion: This is the current narrowest encoder-layer gap. Encoder existence is proven; 10-bit HEIC negotiation is not.
A 10-bit sample container without correct color metadata is not a complete color-still implementation.

layers.evidence_note: The exact runtime VendorTag is seen in historical/community OPlus camera/vendor material, but no project-23821 official public userspace source has yet verified ownership/value/semantics.

needs: bit depth/chroma inspection of actual saved HEIF
layers.conclusion: Intentionally deferred because the current phase is static/public-file research, not device testing.

non_equivalences: P010 allocator support != target Camera HAL ten-bit still exposure
next_static_targets: SM8750 Codec2/OMX vendor implementation or capability descriptors that bind P010/Main10 to c2.qti.heic.encoder
project-23821 camera HAL metadata / stream configuration for dynamic-range ten-bit output
project-23821 OPlus Camera/APS config ownership and value of the 10-bit HEIC runtime gate
still-image CICP/ICC/color metadata handling in OPlus/Qualcomm encode path
